content:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
Butcher with 9 years of experience in meat counter service and butchery, including carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning and fresh sausage production. Trained in butchery and experienced advising customers on cuts and cooking, maintaining cold-chain temperature records, and following hygiene and cleaning routines. HACCP basic food hygiene certificate, renewed in 2024.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Prepare approximately 40 kg of fresh sausage per week in the busy season, including ćevapi, kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback; the ćevapi won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily; rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, with older stock at the front.
- Serve approximately 120 customers on a Saturday and advise on cuts and cooking times.
- Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting orders, including ordering, butchering, seasoning and delivery for weddings and family events. Largest order: four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in 2024.
- Ran a six-week dry-ageing trial for beef ribs, keeping weight-loss and temperature records. Dry-aged ribs are now sold on pre-order, at approximately 15 kg per month.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at close.
- Wrote a one-page closing and cleaning checklist covering the slicer, mincer, counter and floor drain; it remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate in Butchery (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the Master Butcher examination (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) · Boning and trimming · Portioning fresh meat · Fresh sausage making · Knife sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · FIFO stock rotation · Cold-chain temperature checks · HACCP hygiene routines · Customer service and product advice · Cash handling

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good; customer communication) · German (basic)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear headings, relevant experience, quantified workload, customer-service evidence and credible technical detail. The current butcher role is especially effective: carcass volumes, sausage production, customer numbers, temperature checks, FIFO rotation, apprentice training, catering orders and the dry-ageing trial demonstrate practical capability and initiative. The CV is professional, concise and substantially more complete than the original CV. One minor internal issue is that “9 years of experience” may not match the 2015–Present employment dates, depending on the application date. The document also does not explicitly state the candidate’s transferable paper-wrapping experience, although this is not a serious weakness.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is very good. The document uses conventional section headings, reverse-chronological employment history, readable bullet points, standard date formats and no tables, graphics or complex layout elements. It contains strong matching terms including “butcher,” “meat counter,” “carcass breakdown,” “boning,” “trimming,” “portioning,” “fresh sausage,” “FIFO,” “temperature checks,” “HACCP,” “customer service,” “cash handling,” “mincer” and “bandsaw.” AI screening probability is high because the experience is specific, quantified and directly relevant rather than relying only on a generic skills list. For a small ATS improvement, use the exact phrase “HACCP knowledge” in the Skills section. Do not add “forklift” as a skill because the candidate does not hold a forklift licence.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV aligns very strongly with the role and company priorities. It shows completed butcher training, substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience, HACCP training and knowledge, customer advice on cuts and cooking, fresh-meat portioning, stock rotation and twice-daily temperature records. The customer-facing evidence supports FreshCart’s “Ask the counter” promise, while the hygiene routines, training of apprentices and detailed operational records support its emphasis on reliability, hygiene and pride in good work. The candidate’s sausage development, local craft-fair result and event preparation also reinforce product knowledge and practical craftsmanship. The document does not show a forklift licence, which is only a nice-to-have and is a genuine candidate gap. It also does not demonstrate supermarket self-service packaging, tray-sealer use or labelling-scale operation; the candidate’s notes indicate no such experience, so this should not be presented as supermarket experience. The CV nevertheless provides relevant transferable counter and wrapping experience.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR IMPROVEMENTS:
1. In the Professional Profile, check the phrase “9 years of experience” against the application date and the listed employment dates of 2015–Present. If the CV is being submitted in 2026, change it to an accurate duration such as “11 years of experience”; otherwise use a date-neutral wording such as “Butcher with experience since 2015.”
2. In the Skills section, change “HACCP hygiene routines” to “HACCP knowledge and hygiene routines” to mirror the job advertisement’s wording while remaining supported by the HACCP certificate and documented temperature and hygiene checks.
3. Under “Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante,” add one truthful bullet such as “Wrap fresh-meat orders in paper for counter customers.” This shows transferable packaging experience without falsely claiming self-service packaging, tray-sealer or labelling-scale experience.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or at least 2 years at a meat counter
